about: Rules for npm run audit:scan (scripts/audit/autoscan.ts), keyed by the IDs in docs/codex/audit-verified-2026-10-01.json. Each check is absent (a bad call must be gone), present (a replacement must be called from production code), reader (a data file must be read by src/) or test (the test that proves a behavioral item is on main). covers says whether passing every check means the whole item is met; an item covering part can at most scan partly. Taken from each item's evidence lines and next step. Items with no rule scan unknown.
